请求和接收消息的语言类型。
- **zh**（默认）：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the request and response.

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English

description.zh:
用于比较的第二个发布版本UUID。
>历史版本调用[DescribePlaybookReleases](~~DescribePlaybookReleases~~)接口可以获取该参数，新发布版本系统会自动生成。
description.en:
The UUID of the second published version for comparison.

> To obtain the UUID of a historical version, call the [DescribePlaybookReleases](~~DescribePlaybookReleases~~) operation. The system automatically generates a UUID for a new version.

description.zh:
用于比较的第一个发布版本UUID。
>历史版本调用[DescribePlaybookReleases](~~DescribePlaybookReleases~~)接口可以获取该参数，新发布版本系统会自动生成。
description.en:
The UUID of the first published version for comparison.

> To obtain the UUID of a historical version, call the [DescribePlaybookReleases](~~DescribePlaybookReleases~~) operation. The system automatically generates a UUID for a new version.

description.zh:
剧本的UUID。
>调用[DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The UUID of the playbook.

> Call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sophonsoar compare-playbooks --playbook-uuid f916b93e-e814-459f-9662-xxxxx --old-playbook-release-id 1 --new-playbook-release-id 1 --lang zh --api-version 2022-07-28 --region cn-hangzhou
